prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot to move the mold from material station to mobile robot platform.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: material station
What the inspection checks: Check whether the mold is on material station.

The inspection camera's photograph is attached.
observations: The photo shows the labeled material storage rack (silicone/pigment bottle positions, mostly empty holders) viewed at an oblique angle; no mold position is clearly visible or identifiable, so presence of the mold on the material station cannot be determined.
